title: Visualizing Cross Entropy and Information Distance via GZIP Compression
full_prompt:
Write a ManimGL script using InteractiveScene that visualizes the concept of information distance and compression similarity using GZIP as a metaphor. 

1. Create two document representations: 'Document A' and 'Document B'. Each document should consist of 8 stacked horizontal rectangles (width=5, height=1, arranged vertically with no buffer). Document A's rectangles should have varying shades of pink/magenta (using color interpolation between LIGHT_PINK and PURE_MAGENTA). Document B's rectangles should have varying shades of green (interpolating between GREEN_B and GREEN_E). Label them 'Document A' and 'Document B' using TexText and position them side-by-side, then scale and move them to the left side of the screen.

2. Create a combined document 'AB' by copying Document A and appending a snippet (rectangles 4 to 7) of Document B to the bottom. Animate this transition using TransformFromCopy with curved paths (path_arc) to show the parts flying together to form the new document on the right side of the screen.

3. Simulate the compression of this combined document 'AB'. Animate it shrinking/stretching (stretch width/height, remove stroke) to represent a compressed state, and label it 'GZIP(AB)'.

4. Similarly, copy Document A, move it down, and animate its compression into a smaller block labeled 'GZIP(A)'.

5. Fade out the original Document A and B groups, and transition the compressed representations 'GZIP(AB)' and 'GZIP(A)' to the center of the screen, arranging them side-by-side to set up a visual comparison of their sizes. Draw vertical lines next to them to prepare for a difference equation.

visual_techniques: Color interpolation for randomized document textures
Compression visual metaphor via stretching and stroke removal

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using standard Manim Community imports or Scene class instead of ManimGL's InteractiveScene
common_failure_modes.note: The reference code relies on InteractiveScene and manim_imports_ext. Standard Manim Community will fail on InteractiveScene and TexText.
ManimGL uses obj.generate_target() and MoveToTarget(obj). Standard Manim Community sometimes uses different target behaviors or custom custom animations.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing or incorrect color interpolation parameters
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure interpolate_color is used correctly with random.random() to generate the distinct document block shades.
